description: Source code for a web scraper class 'Argiro' that extracts recipe details from the 'argiro.gr' website, including title, author, description, category, times, equipment, yields, ingredients, ingredient groups, and instructions.

classes.name: Argiro
classes.description: A scraper class for extracting recipe data from argiro.gr, inheriting from AbstractScraper.

methods.name: total_time
